findings.message: Normalized full-river UVs leave no legible flow pattern in the bridge camera; derive DUDV from local/world metres and retain temporal runtime evidence.
Cosmetic vertex-wave amplitude exceeds the fixed water-volume contact tolerance; reduce or recalibrate it.
Contracts must inspect material runtime parameters and generated mesh density, not only shader source fragments.
Headless exits report resource leaks; improve isolated teardown before using tests as clean runtime-safety evidence.
